line.comment: * Task 1327.
* Zero Hour
* Turret-only ships can continue moving during in-sector combat (also see !ship.signal.attacked).
* Will be relaunch from !fight.defend.sector.
* Expanded 2.2: ALL owners have to check this, not just the player.
* Police scanning player ships.
* Expanded 2.2: Police enforce illegal-cargo laws against player ships.
* Chasing smugglers!
* SSD prevents the scan.
* Intel mission. The global var is managed in Mayhem.Monitor.Missions.
* 1. Calculate penalties.
* - Fine and reputation loss scale with difficulty.
* - Debt results in increasing reputation loss, at a rate of 1 rep per 100 credits.
* Easy: 0.5x
* Hard: 1.5x
* Insane: 2x
* 2. Apply Consequences.
* Note: infamy is not incurred due to enabling Space Weed production for honorable players.
* Confiscate contraband. Cargo Hauler jobs whose shipments are confiscated are lost.
* Additional reputation loss if the fine cannot be fully paid.
* 3. Format confiscated cargo.
* Add a separator after the first entry.
* 4. Send police report.
* Attack the closest hostile ship.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Only the player can reach here.
* Add-Ons 1.13: Teleporter may be the attack target, so need to guard against TOCTOU here.
* If teleportation is in progress, check the destination ship rather than the temporary teleporter.
* ZH 2.0 - nobody attacks Xenon/OCV-owned ships in a sector protected by Phanon.
* unless during a Xenon Crisis
* ZH 1.9 - Terraformer-owned ships do not attack Terraformer-made ships
* ZH 2.0 - Terraformers don't attack anything if the sector is protected by Phanon.
* ZH 1.10 - Player-owned OCV ships do not attack Terraformer-made ships because their virus will mature.
* Already sorted by closest (tail) to farthest (head).
* Break if outside range.
* ZH 2.0 - Terraformers don't attack anything if the sector is protected by Phanon.
* ZH 2.0 - nobody attacks Xenon/OCV-owned ships in a sector protected by Phanon.
* unless during a Xenon Crisis
* ZH 1.9 - Terraformer owned ships do not attack Terraformer made ships
* ZH 1.10 - Player owned OCV made ships do not attack Terraformer made ships
* Mordan8
* Ships equipped with an SSD have a 10% chance to be attacked. Chance is halved if in active sector.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Now checks for any ship with SSD, not just player ones. Does not use the deprecated pirate cover state variable. This preserves parity.
* Attack normally.
